question.wording: What happened to this Form 1099-R distribution after it was paid?

options.label: Kept — taxable as box 2a prints it
All of it rolled over within 60 days — line 4b/5b is 0
All of it an HSA funding distribution the taxpayer elects to exclude — line 4b is 0
Part rolled over or an HFD — the preparer enters the part not excluded

default.because: A distribution was kept unless a preparer says it was rolled over or was an HSA funding distribution

citation.wording: Generally, a rollover must be made within 60 days after the day you received the distribution.
